title.narrative: Académie de conduite de camions en sécurité

description.narrative: The objective of the proposed project is to support youth employment and address road safety by training certified heavy duty drivers and Moroccan male and female youth. The project will achieve this by establishing a training academy in Morocco, which will offer courses in i) safe and defensive driving and ii) fuel-efficient driving using various types of trucks and buses technologies and under various load configurations as well as iii) relevant soft skills (e.g. driver psychology, environmental impact, health and ergonomics, legislation, insurance system).
